sn2.9:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || Tena kho pana samayena Candimā devaputto Rāhunā asurindena gahito hoti || Atha kho Candimā devaputto Bhagavantam anussaramāno tāyaṃ velāyam imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn2.9:2.1: Namo te buddha vīr-atthu || vippamutto si sabbabhi || sambādhapaṭippanno-smi || tassa me saraṇaṃ bhavāti || ||
sn2.9:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Candimaṃ devaputtam ārabbha Rāhum asurindaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi ||
sn2.9:4.1: Tathāgatam arahantaṃ || Candimā saranaṃ gato || Rāhu candaṃ pamuñcassu || dubbhā lokānukampakāti || ||
sn2.9:5.1: Atha kho Rāhu asurindo Candimaṃ devaputtaṃ muñcitvā taramānarūpo yena Vepacitti asurindo ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || Ekam antaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho Rāhum asurindaṃ Vepacitti asurindo gāthāya ajjhabhāsi ||
sn2.9:6.1: Kinnu santaramāno va || Rāhu candaṃ pamuñcasi || saṃviggarūpo āgamma || kinnu bhīto va tiṭṭhasīti || ||
sn2.9:7.1: Sattabhā me phale muddhā || jīvanto na sukhaṃ labhe || buddhagāthābhihīto-mhi || no ce muñceyya Candimanti || ||
